note: Alberta Parks campground in boreal forest on the west shore of Steele (Cross) Lake, paved drive-in loops under spruce and pine; 34 of the 130 sites are under 23 ft. Sandy beach, pier, hand launch and fish-cleaning stations at the day-use area; forest trails for hiking and mountain biking. --Claude
